notes.title: "Dreaming in Cherry Blossoms, I Fall in Love with You" Release Date Announced✨
notes.notes:
[p]The release date for the visual novel Dreaming in Cherry Blossoms, I Fall in Love with You has been set for July 31, 2025!
Don't forget to add it to your Steam Wishlist![/p][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3690420/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Steam Store Page Major Update ✨ Theme Song & PV Now Available!
notes.notes: [p]We’ve made a major update to the Steam store page for our game![/p][p]The key visual, screenshots, and game description have all been refreshed, and new sections introducing the characters and cast have been added.[/p][p]We’ve also released the promotional video (PV) featuring the theme song “Melody of the Night Sky ～Miracle of the Cherry Blossoms～” sung by Rin Kurusu, who voices Cherry![/p][p]Get an early taste of the game’s world through this special video—be sure to check it out! 🌸[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="feOr1gY963I;full"][/previewyoutube]
